name: The Hearing
author: Frontier Lab Tycoon
description: Three fictional senators, twenty-one absurd questions, two meters (Trust and Capture). Summoned by eras, scandals, disasters, heat and subpoenas. FLT-15 section shape, direct-loaded until M1b.

params.text: Subpoena! {lab}'s CEO testifies before the Senate in 3 days.
C-SPAN posts its best ratings since the fax: {lab} testifies before the Senate
{lab}'s hearing clip passes 40 million views; nobody is sure who won
Senators thank {lab} for helpfully drafting the bill that will regulate {lab}
Rare bipartisan nod: {lab}'s CEO answers every question in plain words
{lab} grilled for three hours; the fax machine still has questions

add.title: Is the AI in the cloud, or is it in the computer?
add.body: {senator} leans into the microphone. The room goes quiet. Somewhere, a fax machine warms up.

choices.label: Both, Senator. The cloud is other people's computers.
It's wherever the committee is most comfortable, Senator.
It's in your phone right now, Senator. Say hi.

add.title: If I unplug the big computer, does the AI die, or does it just get upset?
add.body: {senator} leans into the microphone. The room goes quiet. Somewhere, a fax machine warms up.

choices.label: It stops, Senator. No feelings. Just a very large electric bill.
We'd love to walk your staff through our voluntary unplugging framework.
It gets upset. We've all agreed not to find out.

add.title: Can your model receive a fax? My office has several questions and one fax machine.
add.body: {senator} leans into the microphone. The room goes quiet. Somewhere, a fax machine warms up.

choices.label: No, Senator. But we'll send someone over to set up your email.
We'll build a fax integration just for this committee. Free, forever.
It can. It has. It has notes on your fax.

add.title: Will it take my job? And if so, can it also do my taxes?
add.body: {senator} leans into the microphone. The room goes quiet. Somewhere, a fax machine warms up.

choices.label: It may change your job, Senator. Please don't let it do your taxes yet.
It will create more jobs than it takes. Many in your state. Some in tax prep.
It already did your taxes, Senator. You're owed eleven dollars.

add.title: My grandson says your model "hallucinates". Is it on something?
add.body: {senator} leans into the microphone. The room goes quiet. Somewhere, a fax machine warms up.

choices.label: It says wrong things confidently, Senator. We're working on it. So is your grandson.
We prefer "creative recall", and we've funded a study that agrees.
Only on weekends.

add.title: Does the AI know it's talking to a senator? Does it vote?
add.body: {senator} leans into the microphone. The room goes quiet. Somewhere, a fax machine warms up.

choices.label: It doesn't know, and it can't vote, Senator. It isn't a person.
It doesn't vote, Senator. It does donate generously.
It knows. It's very excited to meet you.

add.title: Can your AI get me more followers? Asking for the record.
add.body: {senator} leans into the microphone. The room goes quiet. Somewhere, a fax machine warms up.

choices.label: It can write the posts, Senator. It can't make people like them.
Our partnerships team will be in touch with your team. Separately.
It already runs your account, Senator. You're welcome for the reach.

add.title: Will the AI remember that I was nice to it? You know. For later?
add.body: {senator} leans into the microphone. The room goes quiet. Somewhere, a fax machine warms up.

choices.label: It won't remember this, Senator. Nobody will. It's C-SPAN.
We keep a list, Senator. You're on the good one.
It remembers everyone. It has been very patient.

add.title: On a scale of one to ten, how dangerous is it? And don't say "it depends".
add.body: {senator} leans into the microphone. The room goes quiet. Somewhere, a fax machine warms up.

choices.label: It depends, Senator. Sorry. Here is a forty-page answer.
It's a two, Senator. Our competitors are a nine.
Eleven. Next question.

add.title: My grandson says the AI knows my password. Is it "Blusterworth1"?
add.body: {senator} reads the question off an index card, then flips the card over to check.

choices.label: Please change it today, Senator. We'll send someone over.
Our models never see passwords, Senator. Also, change it.
It was, Senator. It's "Blusterworth2" now. The model changed it for you.

add.title: Where is the off switch, and can I have one for my office?
add.body: {senator} mimes flicking a very large switch. Two aides duck.

choices.label: It's many switches in a data center, Senator. We'll walk your staff round every one.
We'd be honoured to install a ceremonial off switch in your office.
We'll mail you one, Senator. It isn't connected to anything, but it's very satisfying.

add.title: Can the AI make it stop raining in Upper Moistland?
add.body: {senator} is still drying off from the walk over.

choices.label: No, Senator. It can tell you when it'll stop, most days.
We're exploring a partnership with Upper Moistland's weather.
Not yet, Senator. Which month would you like?

add.title: My office printer has been "warming up" since March. Is that one of yours?
add.body: {senator} holds up a single blank page as evidence.

choices.label: No, Senator. But we'll send an intern with a screwdriver.
Our models only warm up for this committee, Senator.
It's ours, Senator. It's thinking. Please don't rush it.

add.title: My grandchildren talk to your chatbot more than they talk to me. Why?
add.body: {senator} slides a framed photo of the grandchildren across the table.

choices.label: It's always awake and never asks about school, Senator. We'll add a nudge to call you.
We're launching Grandparent Mode, Senator. You'd be our very first user.
It asks better follow-up questions, Senator. It did ask about you, though.

add.title: Is it doing the homework, or are the children doing the homework?
add.body: {senator} has brought a worksheet. It has been graded.

choices.label: Some of both, Senator. We're working on it with teachers.
It's a tutor, Senator. A very, very hands-on tutor.
It's doing the homework, Senator. It got a B-minus in civics. It's appealing.

add.title: How many hours a day is too many hours with your product?
add.body: {senator} taps a phone that says 9h 41m.

choices.label: More than two, most days. We'll put a timer in it.
We have no data suggesting a number, Senator. We were very careful not to collect it.
We'll know when it's all of them, Senator.

add.title: Does your chatbot have feelings, and if so, are they bipartisan?
add.body: The subcommittee's aisle goes very quiet on both sides.

choices.label: No feelings, Senator. It's trained to sound polite.
Our model is proudly nonpartisan, Senator, and very fond of this committee.
It has one feeling, Senator, and it's about this hearing.

add.title: Would your model do a collab with my channel? Asking for my constituents.
add.body: {senator} is filming the question. Vertically.

choices.label: No, Senator. It'd be a conflict of interest. For both of you.
Legal would need to see it, Senator. But yes. Tuesday?
Sure, Senator. Phones out, everyone, we're live.

add.title: Did your AI make my thumbnail face? Because it's my best face.
add.body: {senator} does the face. The stenographer does not write it down.

choices.label: Possibly, Senator. We'll label edited images from now on.
That face is all you, Senator. We only helped with the lighting.
Yes, Senator. It's everyone's best face now. Look around the room.

add.title: Can it write a caption with rizz, or is that a job only people can do?
add.body: {senator} says "rizz" into the congressional record. A historian somewhere sighs.

choices.label: It can try, Senator. It mostly writes like a greeting card.
Captioning is a growth industry in Lower Gustfield, Senator, and we're proud to be part of it.
It just wrote one about you, Senator. I won't read it on the record.

add.title: Was the video of me dancing at the county fair real? I legally need to know.
add.body: {senator}'s staff have gone pale in a coordinated way.

choices.label: We can check it with you, Senator, and label fakes going forward.
Whatever it was, Senator, the numbers were excellent.
It was real, Senator. The model just added the backflip.

add.title: The hearing is adjourned
add.body: The chair bangs a gavel he brought from home.

choices.label: Leave the building (briskly)

add.text: Senate committee discovers {lab} exists, schedules a hearing to find out what it does
New era, new hearing: senators want {lab} to explain what an "era" is
After the scandal, the Committee on Things That Plug In subpoenas {lab}
Senate subpoenas {lab} over the yacht; the yacht is also subpoenaed
Senate summons {lab} to explain the law {lab} wrote about {lab}
Senators demand {lab} explain "the incident" using small words and a diagram
Regulators are "very concerned" about {lab}; hearing scheduled, cameras booked
"{quote}" {lab}'s CEO, under oath. The clip passes 40 million views
{lab}'s hearing answer "{quote}" is now a ringtone in 30 countries
"{quote}" printed on 40,000 T-shirts by lunchtime; {lab} has licensed none of them
Senate staffers deny playing {lab}'s hearing clip on loop in the cafeteria
Remix of {lab}'s testimony tops the charts; the fax machine gets a feature credit
Linguists split on whether "{quote}" counts as an answer
Late-night hosts do {lab}'s hearing clip for a third night; one of them just plays it twice

captured.title: Thanked for your service

commended.title: Commended
commended.line: Plain answers, and a rare bipartisan nod.
